summary: Complete implementation plan for the RedRob Hackathon "Intelligent Candidate Discovery & Ranking Challenge". The challenge requires building a ranking system that processes 100K candidate profiles against a Senior AI Engineer job description, producing a top-100 ranked list with reasoning. Key constraints: 5-min CPU-only execution, 16GB RAM, no network. The plan covers a multi-stage pipeline: (1) Honeypot detection to filter ~80 impossible profiles, (2) Hard-filter elimination of disqualified candidates per JD, (3) Multi-dimensional scoring across 6 axes (skills match, career quality, behavioral signals, experience fit, education, availability), (4) Final ranking with reasoning generation. The approach emphasizes semantic understanding over keyword matching, incorporates behavioral signals as availability multipliers, and includes trap candidate detection.
